notes.title: CDF Ghostship - The final build! (pre-release)
notes.content:
CDF Ghostship (Beta 1.9 - |Pre Release Build)
We have now released the pre-release version of CDF Ghostship.  This is now the final pre-release version and is the full game.  We have worked with the community for almost 9 months to bring you a better game than would have otherwise been possible.  Thanks to all those who helped with bug reports, feedback and videos along the way.  The final release build will include ending cinematics & Credits as well as any necessary fixes which may be found in this pre-release build.  We are going to full release status on the 23rd June.

This final pre-release build has had many fixes and improvements as well as some of the “junk” trimmed off.  A full changelog from 1.8 to 1.9 will be updated here shortly.

Thank you for your support, Enjoy the game!

Shaun Williams
Lead Developer


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Pre release Build (beta 1.9) notes 


Changelog from 1.8 - 1.9
------------------------------------

Fixed custom keybinds
Inventory Fully operational
17 Weapons in the game
More than 20 enemies + ranged human enemies now in game
Improved AI and path fining
EASY Mode works as intended (for the too hard brigade!)
Story Mode fully working with all storylines and 4 different endings!
Space station added
Weapon tac lights - increased brightness
Weapon improvements and rebalancing
Slightly better optimised for performance
Custom quick save slot - Press F5 to instant save, Press F8 to load it
Escsape key now goes to exit menu (pauses game)
Skirmish mode replaced
Eplorer mode removed
Odes to jim Sterling & MAC - WAB 
Touble Tab Crouch to toggle (necessary for air shafts in space station)
New achievements and all previous ones fixed.
Crew members Added to Roster
Alien Eggs Added.
More special Effects added.
More misc. fixes and improvements.

Weapon improvements and rebalancing

Touble Tab Crouch to toggle (necessary for air shafts in space station)

(Please be aware that changing 32bit/64bit will require to start a new game)

Thanks

Increased Sprint to 11 seconds 
Fixed Death in Enginnering at start - lights Out Crash 
No Aliens in CArgo Hold on Free roaming Explorer sim 
Paths Ruibuilt In Cargo hold and other areas 
Added more medikits 
Fixed remote access terminal in Hangar 2 
Fixed out of world bug in Sub Access Corridor 
Clip count stays on screen a little longer 
Replaced Plasma Pistol 
Replaced Shotgun 
Replaced SMG 
Added HAW (Heavy Assualt Weapon) 
Cleaned up Zombie Physics 
Cleaned Up Lurker Physics 
Added some new zombies 


Have fun with the new build, and dont forget!  Look for weapons!

notes.title: 25% off! Help us to help you!
notes.content:
This is our last sale in early access and we are offering 25% off for the next week in a final push to get some final funds together to improve some of the enemies and animations.  We have reached the final leg of development and some aspects we wish to improve for the final release is all down to how many of you come on board the Ghostship.  We have lots of content and bugs are now few and far between so now would be a great time to jump on board and give you guys a better and more polished game.

Thanks for supporting CDF Ghostship and I look forward to bringing you the 1.5 update in just over a week.

Shaun Williams
Lead Developer 

EDIT:

We will temporarily stop selling CDF Ghostship early May in preparation for the game's full version release the first week in June. Any money we get in May will be too late to re-invest into the release version so we'd rather not mess with it, and instead get hyper-focused on getting this finished during that time.

It's no secret money has been tight, there's no publisher and no uber successful kickstarter campaign, so help us help you by supporting this last leg of development so we can make those improvements we've been wanting and just haven't been able to afford.

If you've been keeping an eye on this game there's no better time to get it than now, and a little bird told me that if we sell 700 copies this week we will be able to get custom keybinds in version 1.5! So please, tell your friends, your neighbors, your best friends and worst enemies, do it for the keybinds!

- Pingy

tags.feature: - If we sell 700 copies this week we will be able to get custom keybinds in version 1.5!

notes.title: Beta 1.4 Released!
notes.content:
CDF Ghostship 1.4 has been released!
----------------------------------------------------

Hi everyone,  Beta 1.4 is now available.  In this version we have added 3 difficulty modes to story mode which will suit both sides of the camp.  We have also added more achievements as well as a few secret ones.

Changlog from 1.3 to 1.4
---------------------------------

Fixed typos on medical logs and autopsy reports
Added 4 More autopsy Logs
Added 14 new achievements
Added 3 difficulty Modes for Story Mode
AI tweaks
Replaced Elliot Voice
Fixed aliens appearing in when in Explorer mode
Added Escape option to story mode intro
Decreased hit points on worms and jump distance


Our next update 1.5 will be released at the beginning of April, Thanks to some help from Marc, we should be able include custom keybinds in 1.5.

notes.content:
I am happy to announce that update 1.3 is now live.  Be sure to restart steam if the update does not download automatically.  This update is a little longer as i have also been off ill for a week,  I’m only human.

notes.title: Update 1.15 Released
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Today we are releasing update 1.15 (3.8 gb) in our efforts to provide the best game possible. Update 1.15 is a vast improvement over the previous build in terms of graphics and game-play.  We truly appreciate everyone who has invested in the game so far and will do our best to provide you with the finished product you expect, even if we can't hire more help and it takes a little longer than we had hoped. 

Sincerely, 
Shaun 


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

Changelog from 1.14 to 1.15 

Various AI tweaks
New Plasma pistol with laser sight
All weapons are now accurate
Fixed lighting on doors
Added a New simulation - Last Survivor
Enhanced Weapon sights on Battle rifle, assault rifle and Mk4 4 prototype
Added more graphics options
Enabled 3d support (stereoscopic - side by side for 3d monitors)
Fixed popping up enemies
Re-balanced story mode 
Reduced most AI`s hit points slightly
Improved Lighting
Laser pistol and laser rifle recharge quicker
Reduced some swarms in story mode
Fixed Scavenger Challenge
Faster reload times on plasma weapons
Added shades and improved weapons
Made some weapons smaller such pistols and some rifles
Fixed more collision issues
Removed collision form dead bodies and cables in hangar
Lots of new and improved textures
Fixed longs waits between waves in onslaught mode
Fixed various typos
Moved shield in deck 1 elevator so its easier to get to.
Increased brightness and range on weapon tac lights
fixed all old flickering lights
New post process effects
Numerous other fixes and improvements.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


The game now plays and looks much better, some users on low end - medium machines may notice a slight FPS drop in 1.15


There are weapon and enemy guides available in the guides section!  These will soon be updated with the changes made in 1.15

We truly appreciate everyone who has invested in the game so far and will do our best to provide you with the finished product you expect, even if we can't hire more help and it takes a little longer than we had hoped. 

Sincerely, 
Shaun

notes.title: Update 1.12 Now Live
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we are releasing update 1.12 in our efforts to provide the best game possible.  Unfortunately sales weren't high enough to hire the help needed to include the graphics options and additional challenge mode we had planned on and had announced previously, and we sincerely apologize for this.

We truly appreciate everyone who has invested in the game so far and will do our best to provide you with the finished product you expect, even if we can't hire more help and it takes a little longer than we had hoped.

Sincerely,
Pingy


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Changelog from 1.1 to 1.12

- Fixed menu problems with ASMI voice playing when exiting.
- Fixed menu so everything should be working as normal
- Replaced a number of textures and worked on lighting (to many to mention individually)
- Improved zombie AI
- Added another zombie attack animation
- Added the lurker enemy
- Added the Skinny Enemy
- Tweaked all AI to work better and animate better
- Fixed Steel Arena simulation - Now works as it should
- Fixed Deck 2 Emergency simulation
- Fixed Getting on Bunker on Colony Day Onslaught
- Fixed no enemies spawn after round 2 wave 2 on Colony Day & COlony Night onslaught
- Tweaked all onslaught maps and added new enemies
- Removed flamethrower from most onslaught maps and story mode (until more refined)
- Improved Story mode (all round)
- Added New Simulation - MeatBalls & Custard
- Added voice overs for simulation mode
- Improved sounds - various
- Fixed hud displaying on simulations
- Fixed hud not displaying after lockdown disabled on bridge
- Changed all game modes to use "Tab Exit" Escape exit will be changed for next update
- Changed AI so none should - Pop up
- Changed more flickering lights to be slower and more subtle
- Plasma SMG now mapped to the number 1 key
- Plasma MG now mapped to the number 9 key
- Flamethrower now mapped to the number 0 key
- Made Hanger 2 onslaught map brighter
- Introduced an old enemy - The Biter (Alien Species Type E as referred to by CDF) 
- Introduced an old enemy - The Big Biter (Alien Species Type E as referred to by CDF) 
- Added a few surprises! - Be sure to play through story mode a few times.
- Minor improvements in all game modes

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: First Update - This Friday!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, Its been a week now since the first CDF Ghostship build was launched, we will be following up with the 2nd build 1.12 in a few days.
